cases.name: test-handle-errors-normal-1
cases.description: Verify the shell reports an error and stays active when given a non-existent command.
cases.expected_behavior: The shell should output an error message to standard error and continue running.

cases.name: test-handle-errors-normal-2
cases.description: Verify the shell can execute valid commands after encountering a failed command.
cases.expected_behavior: Subsequent valid commands execute successfully after an error.

cases.name: test-handle-errors-edge-1
cases.description: Verify empty command inputs do not trigger fatal execution faults.
cases.expected_behavior: The shell handles empty or whitespace-only execution requests safely.

cases.name: test-handle-errors-oracle-1
cases.description: Verify random invalid inputs trigger resilient handling under dynamic evaluation.
cases.expected_behavior: Arbitrary non-existent commands are caught and reported cleanly.
